fieldNotes.truckGate: Head-on Street View (pano qoLxZOYA2rYLsJYzemb2Tw, 2026-03) shows a chain-link sliding gate across a wide truck driveway off New Salem Hwy, with cones marking lanes and HFD trailers staged just inside.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white windowed booth set beside the gate driveway (visible in SV heading 300/320 and z20 satellite) = staffed guard shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved apron inside the gate holds staged trailers before they move to the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved gate apron plus internal road can hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate sits directly on New Salem Hwy, a busy 4-lane divided highway near a signalized intersection; a queue would back toward the road.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron with unused paved width beside the booth offers room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Doors counted along the south building face under backed-in trailers; ~22 estimated, banded 10-25 (overhead count approximate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large dedicated trailer drop yard in angled rows on the N, W and S sides; 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of Murfreesboro, TN inside the metro's developed commercial fabric (storage facilities, retail, residential adjacent) = Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant + wastewater/treatment building + pump/utility structures at the SW ponds.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear concentrated on the south face; no clearly separate second ship/rcv bank confirmed.
